definitions.gloss: side job done at home; piecework; cottage industry work
definitions.explanation: Work done at home for extra income, typically simple manual tasks like assembly, packaging, or addressing envelopes. Traditionally associated with housewives earning supplementary income.

definitions.gloss: doing something else secretly; doing unrelated work during class or a meeting
definitions.explanation: Doing something unrelated during a meeting, class, or other activity where one should be paying attention. A colloquial extension of the original meaning.

examples.japanese: {内職|ないしょく}で{家計|かけい}を{助|たす}ける。
examples.english: To help the household finances with side work.

examples.japanese: {母|はは}は{子育|こそだ}てをしながら{内職|ないしょく}をしていた。
examples.english: My mother did piecework at home while raising children.

examples.japanese: {在宅|ざいたく}の{内職|ないしょく}で{月|つき}に{数万円|すうまんえん}{稼|かせ}いでいる。
examples.english: I earn tens of thousands of yen a month from home-based side work.

examples.japanese: {授業中|じゅぎょうちゅう}に{内職|ないしょく}するな。
examples.english: Don't work on other things during class.

examples.japanese: {会議中|かいぎちゅう}にこっそり{内職|ないしょく}していた。
examples.english: I was secretly working on something else during the meeting.

examples.japanese: {先生|せんせい}の{目|め}を{盗|ぬす}んで{内職|ないしょく}していたら、{見|み}つかってしまった。
examples.english: I was secretly doing other work when the teacher wasn't looking, but got caught.

notes:
Composed of {内|ない} (inside, home) + {職|しょく} (work, job). Originally refers to piecework done at home — a traditional way for homemakers to earn extra income. The word has developed a common colloquial sense of secretly doing unrelated work during class or meetings.

USAGE:
Sense 2 is very common among students, who use {内職|ないしょく} to mean studying for another subject or doing homework during a boring class. In office settings, it refers to working on personal tasks or other projects during meetings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {内職|ないしょく}をする — to do side work / to work on the side
- {在宅|ざいたく}{内職|ないしょく} — work-from-home side job
- {内職|ないしょく}{商法|しょうほう} — home-work scam (fraudulent schemes)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {副業|ふくぎょう} — side job, second job; broader and more modern term for any secondary work
- アルバイト — part-time job; typically outside the home
